channel.title: Wartabiye TV
channel.description: Wararka Soomaaliya, Afrika, adduunka iyo ciyaaraha.

item.title: Kimi Antonelli oo noqday horyaalka adduunka ee ugu da’da yar taariikhda Formula 1
item.description: Darawalka Mercedes Kimi Antonelli oo 20 jir ah ayaa kaalinta 3-aad ka galay Mexico City Grand Prix, wuxuuna ku guuleystay horyaalnimada darawallada, halka Max Verstappen uu ku guuleystay tartanka, sida ay FIA sheegtay.

item.title: Serie A: Juventus oo 2-0 garaacday Napoli, Lazio oo kaalinta koowaad qabsatay
item.description: Juventus ayaa 2-0 kaga adkaatay Napoli oo 10 ciyaartoy ku dhammeysatay, halka Lazio oo 2-1 garaacday Cagliari ay markii ugu horreysay 16 sano kadib hoggaanka Serie A qabsatay, sida ay Football Italia ku warantay.

item.title: Baarlamaanka Carabta oo cambaareeyay weerarkii markabka gaaska ee Qatar
item.description: Baarlamaanka Carabta ayaa si adag u cambaareeyay bartilmaameedsiga markabka gaaska dareeraha ah (LNG) ee Al Mayeda ee Qatar, intii uu marayay Gacanka Carabta, wuxuuna ka digay in weerarradaas ay khatar ku yihiin amniga gobolka iyo sahayda tamarta, sida ay SONNA ku warantay.

item.title: Isbitaalka Erdogan ee Muqdisho oo keenay qalab casri ah oo lagu ogaado kansarka
item.description: Isbitaalka Recep Tayyip Erdogan (Digfeer) ee Muqdisho ayaa qaybtiisa baaritaanka unugyada ku daray saddex mashiin oo markii ugu horreysay la keenay Soomaaliya, sida uu Dawan Africa u sheegay madaxa qaybta, Dr. Ismaaciil Maxamuud Cabdullaahi.

item.title: Premier League: Arsenal oo 1-0 kaga adkaatay Liverpool, hoggaankana qabsatay
item.description: Gool uu Kai Havertz dhaliyay daqiiqadii 16-aad ayaa Arsenal u horseeday guushii ugu horreysay ee ay Anfield ka gaarto 14 sano gudahood, waxayna u gudubtay kaalinta koowaad ee Premier League, sida ay AP ku warantay.

item.title: Bundesliga: Eintracht Frankfurt oo 3-1 kaga adkaatay Hamburger SV
item.description: Eintracht Frankfurt ayaa 3-1 ku garaacday Hamburger SV, waxayna u dalacday kaalinta 8-aad ee Bundesliga, sida ay Bulinews iyo IANS ku warrameen.

item.title: LaLiga: Real Madrid oo 3-0 kaga adkaatay Racing Santander
item.description: Real Madrid ayaa qeybtii hore saddex gool ku dhalisay garoonka Racing Santander, waxayna gaartay guushii lixaad oo isku xigta, sida ay muujiyeen warbixinnada kooxda iyo ESPN.

item.title: SomBank iyo IBS Bank oo maalgelin Islaami ah u fidiyay kalluumeysatada Soomaaliyeed
item.description: SomBank ayaa sheegtay inay kalluumeysatada Soomaaliyeed siisay maalgelin Islaami ah oo gaareysa ilaa $2 milyan, halka IBS Bank ay soo bandhigtay adeeg cusub oo lagu magacaabo “Kalluun Kaabe”, sida ay Dawan Africa ku warantay.

item.title: Barnaamijka Saudi Noor oo Muqdisho ka bilaabay daaweyn iyo qalliin bilaash ah oo indhaha
item.description: Barnaamijka bani’aadminnimo ee Saudi Noor 2026 ayaa Isbitaalka Madiina ee Muqdisho ka bilaabay adeegyo bilaash ah oo daryeelka indhaha, kuwaas oo lagu wado inay gaaraan ku dhawaad 500 bukaan, sida ay Dawan Africa ku warantay.

item.title: Ligue 1: Marseille oo 2-0 kaga adkaatay Toulouse garoonka Vélodrome
item.description: Olympique de Marseille ayaa 2-0 ku garaacday Toulouse ciyaar ka tirsan wareegga 9-aad ee Ligue 1, sida ay Foot Mercato ku warantay.

item.title: Shirka COP17 oo Yerevan ku ansixiyay qorshe lagu dardargelinayo ilaalinta dabeecadda
item.description: Dalalka ka qeybgalay Shirka QM ee Kala-duwanaanshaha Noolaha (COP17) ee caasimadda Armenia ayaa ku heshiiyay “Yerevan Pathway”, oo ah qorshe lagu dardargelinayo 23-ka hadaf ee la doonayo in la gaaro 2030, sida ay UN News ku warantay.

item.title: Mo Ibrahim: Dimuqraadiyadda iyo xuquuqda aadanaha Afrika waa hoos u dhacayaan
item.description: Mo Ibrahim, aasaasaha hay’adda Mo Ibrahim Foundation, ayaa wakaaladda AFP u sheegay in dimuqraadiyadda iyo xuquuqda aadanaha ay Afrika hoos ugu dhacayaan. Tusmada hay’addu waxay muujisay horumar dhaqaale, balse hoos u dhac xagga amniga iyo ka qeybgalka dadweynaha.

item.title: Madaxweyne Cirro oo Hargeysa ku guddoomay warqadaha aqoonsiga safiirka Israa’iil
item.description: Sida ay Dawan Africa ku warantay, Madaxweynaha Somaliland Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi (Cirro) ayaa Axaddii qasriga madaxtooyada ee Hargeysa ku guddoomay warqadaha aqoonsiga Michael Lotem, oo ah safiirka Israa’iil u fadhiya Somaliland.

item.title: Hawlgalkii QM ee Saxaraha Galbeed (MINURSO) oo dhammaaday kadib 35 sano
item.description: Muddada hawlgalka MINURSO ayaa dhammaatay saqdii dhexe ee Sabtida kadib markii Golaha Ammaanka uu ku heshiin waayay mustaqbalkiisa. Xoghayaha Guud António Guterres ayaa sheegay in QM ay diyaar u tahay inay sii taageerto dadaallada nabadda, sida ay UN News ku warantay.

item.title: Boosaaso oo lagu qabtay tartankii ugu horreeyay ee kubadda cagta xeebta Soomaaliya
item.description: Sida ay Dawan Africa ku warantay, Xiriirka Kubadda Cagta Puntland iyo Xiriirka Kubadda Cagta Soomaaliya ayaa 30 Oktoobar Boosaaso ka furay tartan kubadda cagta xeebta ah oo ay ka qayb galayaan 6 kooxood, kaas oo markii ugu horreysay ay haweenku ka muuqdaan.

item.title: Soomaaliya oo ka qayb gashay furitaanka Ciyaaraha Olombikada Dhallinyarada ee Dakar 2026
item.description: Calanka Soomaaliya ayaa ka mid ahaa kuwa lagu soo bandhigay furitaanka Ciyaaraha Olombikada Dhallinyarada ee Dakar 2026, oo socon doona 31 Oktoobar ilaa 13 Nofembar. Soomaaliya waxaa matalaya feeryahanka 17 jirka ah Xasan Anwar oo ku tartamaya miisaanka 50 kiilo.

item.title: Golden State Valkyries oo ku guuleystay horyaalkii ugu horreeyay ee WNBA
item.description: Sida ay wakaaladda AP ku warantay, Golden State Valkyries ayaa ciyaartii 7aad ee finalka WNBA ku garaacday Atlanta Dream 68-63, waxayna qaadeen horyaalkoodii ugu horreeyay, iyagoo ku jira xilli-ciyaareedkoodii 2aad oo keliya.

item.title: Lewis Hamilton oo ka bilaabaya safka hore Mexico City Grand Prix
item.description: Sida ay Sky Sports ku warantay, Lewis Hamilton ayaa markii ugu horreysay isagoo u tartamaya Ferrari ku guuleystay booska koowaad ee bilowga (pole) ee Mexico City Grand Prix, isagoo ka horreeyay George Russell iyo Charles Leclerc.

item.title: Canelo Álvarez oo dib u qaatay suunka WBC ee miisaanka super-middleweight
item.description: Sida ay Sky Sports ku warantay, feeryahanka reer Mexico Canelo Álvarez ayaa magaalada Riyadh go’aan ay garsoorayaasha oo dhammi isku raaceen kaga adkaaday Christian Mbilli, oo ahaa horyaal aan weli laga badin, wuxuuna dib ula noqday suunka WBC.

item.title: Nigeria oo baaraysa laba kiis oo looga shakiyay Ebola
item.description: Sida ay Al Jazeera ku warantay, Xarunta Nigeria ee La-dagaallanka iyo Ka-hortagga Cudurrada (NCDC) ayaa sheegtay in waqooyi-bari dalka laga helay laba qof oo looga shakiyay Ebola; waa la go’doomiyay, baaritaan shaybaarna waa lagu wadaa.

item.title: Midowga Yurub oo baaraya warar sheegaya in markab kalluumeysi oo Iiraan leedahay lagu afduubay xeebaha Bari
item.description: Hawlgalka badda ee Midowga Yurub, ATALANTA, ayaa baaraya warar sheegaya in burcad-badeed ay 29 Oktoobar afduubeen markabka kalluumeysiga Azini ee Iiraan leedahay, meel u dhow degmada Bandarbeyla. Xarunta Amniga Badda ee MSCIO ayaa maraakiibta ganacsiga ugu baaqday inay feejignaan muujiyaan.

item.title: Soomaaliya iyo Cumaan oo ka wada hadlay ballaarinta ganacsiga iyo maalgashiga
item.description: Wasiirka Ganacsiga iyo Warshadaha, Jamaal Maxamed Xasan, ayaa Muqdisho kula kulmay safiirka Cumaan u fadhiya Soomaaliya, Saalim bin Xabiib Al Camiri. SONNA ayaa sheegtay in kulanku diiradda saaray xoojinta ganacsiga labada dal iyo abuurista fursado cusub oo ganacsi.

item.title: Soomaaliya iyo Ruushka oo ka wada hadlay iskaashiga amniga iyo tababarka booliska
item.description: Wasiirka Amniga Gudaha, Cabdullaahi Sheekh Ismaaciil (Fartaag), ayaa la kulmay Igor Zubov, ku-xigeenka Wasiirka Arrimaha Gudaha Ruushka. Zubov ayaa sheegay in dowladdiisu diyaar u tahay inay la wadaagto aqoonta iyo tababarka la dagaallanka dambiyada, sida uu sheegay Goobjoog.

item.title: Dowladda federaalka oo bilowday qorshaynta waddo 110 km ah oo isku xirta Buuhoodle iyo Tuulo-Samakaab
item.description: Horseed Media ayaa sheegtay in Wasiir Ayuub Ismaaciil oo ka tirsan dowladda federaalka uu saxiixay qorshaha waddada, iyadoo uu goobta joogay Xildhibaan Cabdi Qawdhan. Xildhibaanku wuxuu sheegay in mashruucu yahay guul weyn oo nolosha dadka deegaanka beddeli doona.

item.title: Barcelona oo 6-1 ku jabisay Alavés, Lamine Yamal-na 2 gool dhaliyay
item.description: Sida ay ESPN ku warantay, Barcelona ayaa 6-1 kaga adkaatay Alavés garoonka Spotify Camp Nou, waxayna dib ugu laabatay hoggaanka La Liga.

item.title: Bayern iyo Dortmund oo 2-2 ku kala baxay, Harry Kane-na rigoore ayuu khasaariyay
item.description: Sida ay ESPN ku warantay, Bayern Munich iyo Borussia Dortmund ayaa garoonka Allianz Arena 2-2 ku kala baxay ciyaarta Der Klassiker ee Bundesliga.

item.title: AC Milan oo 3-1 kaga adkaatay Inter ciyaarta derby-ga Milan
item.description: Sida ay ESPN ku warantay, AC Milan ayaa garoonka San Siro 3-1 kaga guuleysatay Inter, waxayna joojisay taxanaha Inter ee 9 ciyaarood oo horyaal ah oo aan laga badin.

item.title: Washington DC iyo Virginia oo dacwad ka gudbiyay qorshaha qaansada guusha ee Trump
item.description: Sida ay Al Jazeera ku warantay, Washington DC iyo gobolka Virginia ayaa maxkamad federaal ah ka codsaday inay joojiso qorshaha Madaxweyne Trump ee ah in qaanso guul (triumphal arch) laga dhiso Memorial Circle, iyagoo ku tilmaamay mid sharci-darro ah.

item.title: Erdoğan oo ugu baaqay Ruushka iyo Ukraine inay joojiyaan weerarrada Badda Madow
item.description: Sida ay Al Jazeera ku warantay, Madaxweynaha Turkiga Recep Tayyip Erdoğan ayaa magaalada Istanbul, isagoo la taagan Madaxweyne Volodymyr Zelenskyy, ku sheegay in weerarrada lagu qaado maraakiibta rayidka ee Badda Madow aan la aqbali karin, cid kasta oo fulisaba.

item.title: Guddiga Doorashooyinka oo furay diiwaangelinta ururrada siyaasadda ka hor doorashooyinka 2027
item.description: Sida ay Dawan Africa ku warantay, diiwaangelinta ururrada siyaasadda ayaa socon doonta 1 ilaa 22 Nofembar. Soomaaliya waxay isu diyaarinaysaa doorashada baarlamaanka ee Abriil 2027 iyo doorashada madaxtooyada ee Maajo 2027.
